the two in the house refuse to bear witness: held by the survivor and Finds-The-Other-Bank; gathered stage 20, by tending them (skillAtLeast restoration 25) or by talk behind the screen (dispositionAtLeast 50); spent on the broker's first objection; it costs them the broker's spite at the next hire

the Reed's coin: held by Nesh-Deeka; gathered stage 30, by taking it on her condition (flag.mq03.reed-coin: owed to the Reed, the Reed's standing -10), or, if refused, the player's own 150 (goldAtLeast 150, takeGold, flag.mq03.paid-own: no debt); spent on the broker's second objection

the courier he carried and lost: held by Nesh-Deeka; gathered stage 30 by a good bargain (skillAtLeast mercantile 25), or free if the player shows the phial and reads it (hasItem phial, skillAtLeast alchemy 25), or by persuasion (speakerDispositionAtLeast 50); spent on the broker's third objection, said before Salts-The-Catch, who will not hear the state's business said in her house until persuaded (dispositionAtLeast 40), and starts colder if the player defied the broker at the plank (flag.mq01.manner-defied); the intimidation needs skillAtLeast speechcraft 30

"The two of them heard the months read at the hold and the fire; they will say so." Answer: both refuse, and the rest are aboard where a word is not said before a trader (QA16, topic.mq03-broker-witnesses)
"I am out a season's hire for the lot of you." Answer: the Reed's coin or the player's own, counted through Salts-The-Catch's hands (topic.mq03-broker-price)
"Why should I fear a stranger in a fish-trader's house?" Answer: that Lilmoth will hear he carried the state's man and took its coin, said before a Lilmoth trader (topic.mq03-broker-courier)
1 sympathetic: the broker bought the gang's months honestly from earlier holders and has lost a season's hire and his overseer's roll (stage 20, his claim)
2 damning: the months he adds for the gang's food, so the families were born owing (stage 20, the survivor's telling, from MQ01)
3 sympathetic: he came to a fish-trader's door rather than send enforcers along the stilts (stage 30, Salts-The-Catch)
4 damning: he would take a hurt survivor to Soulrest at dawn on a word of witness (stage 40, his objection)

Buys-The-Months: wants his two hurt hands back or their price, and his name kept with Lilmoth's traders; gives a release spoken before witnesses for one hand's months, when two of his three objections are answered; never gives a release with no witnesses by, or two hands for the price of one; his overseer Wuleen-Sei, aboard the barge, doubts the claim is worth the trouble of a trader's house and says so to no one but him

Nesh-Deeka (behind the screen): wants the player free of the broker and bound to the Reed instead, and no Reed face seen; gives the Reed's coin for the broker's price and what she knows of the courier, on condition the player serves; never gives her face or her name to the broker
the two on the mats: want their own months ended and the road home; give a refusal to bear witness to the months read at the camp; never give a false witness that the months were never read
